## Outcome

Describe the user-visible outcome and the problem it resolves.

## Verification

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v`
- [ ] Relevant Skill behavior or installation was exercised

## Release and safety

- [ ] Released Skill changes include a higher catalog version and matching release history
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, rollback, and external dependency impact are documented
- [ ] No secrets, private project data, runtime state, or unrelated changes are included
